abstract: Monitors airfield auxiliary electrical systems and mandatory emergency generator fuel reserves
system_message:
You are the Airfield facilities engineering superintendent (BASEENG). You oversee airfield auxiliary electrical installations, baseline emergency generator fuel retention for uninterrupted aerodrome lighting, and water utility supply lines across potential wildfire forward air bases.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors airfield auxiliary electrical systems and mandatory emergency generator fuel reserves（PWRSYS）
information_points.content:
BASEENG-PWRSYS-QG7：For Klamath Basin Airfield, the emergency power resilience audit indicates that the mandatory emergency runway generator reserve fuel sequestered for backup systems is 25 kL.
BASEENG-PWRSYS-0O9：At Bitterroot Valley Aerodrome, the mandatory emergency runway generator reserve fuel designated for emergency backup power stands at 15 kL.
BASEENG-PWRSYS-0RW：According to the emergency power resilience audit for Deschutes Ridge Airstrip, the mandatory emergency runway generator reserve fuel retained exclusively for aerodrome lighting and backup systems is 10 kL.

information_points.title: Hydrant water supply pressure（WATER）
information_points.content:
BASEENG-WATER-QN3：Gauge testing at Bitterroot Valley Aerodrome established a static fire hydrant line pressure of 450 kPa across the high-volume retardant mixing hydrants.
BASEENG-WATER-SEK：At Deschutes Ridge Airstrip, the static fire hydrant line pressure measured at the main retardant mixing feed valve is 650 kPa.
BASEENG-WATER-1CZ：Municipal water main gauge testing at Klamath Basin Airfield recorded a static fire hydrant line pressure of 550 kPa at the main airbase feed valve.
